categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Boshijie Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the IoT intelligent hardware sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of smart vehicle terminals, smart travel components, smart sleep terminals, smart payment hardware, other smart hardware, and wireless communication modules. The company serves multiple IoT application fields including intelligent transportation, smart travel, smart payment, and smart sleep. It also has subsidiaries engaged in software development and industrial leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in communication, positioning, and AI algorithms, with self-developed wireless communication modules supporting 2G to 4G and NB-IoT standards. It employs a 'module + platform + terminal' business model, integrating wireless modules with cloud management platforms and terminal products. Production follows a sales-driven model with core processes like SMT patching, assembly, programming, and testing done in-house, supported by ISO9001, IATF16949, and ISO14001 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include vehicle fleet operators, shared mobility service providers, mobile payment platforms, and smart sleep industry players. Notable clients are Tencent's financial payment platform, major shared bike brands like Didi's Qingju, Hello Bike, and Meituan Bike, as well as commercial vehicle companies such as Sany Heavy Industry and Zoomlion. The company targets markets in intelligent transportation, smart travel, mobile payment, and health-related smart sleep sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for over 76% of revenue, and has rapidly expanding overseas markets including Southeast Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Europe/America. Overseas revenue grew by nearly 400% in 2024, supported by localized R&D and marketing teams. Subsidiaries are located in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Boshijie operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IoT supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of wireless communication modules and intelligent terminal products. It maintains vertical integration by self-developing core modules and assembling end products, while sourcing raw materials like chips and electronic components from upstream suppliers. The company also collaborates closely with downstream vehicle operation service providers for product deployment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in communication, positioning, and AI technologies, with ongoing R&D in AI vision algorithms, 3D reconstruction, super-resolution imaging, and multi-source fusion positioning systems. It emphasizes product upgrades for intelligent transportation, smart travel, smart payment, and smart sleep applications, and invests in overseas localization of technology. Future R&D focuses include AI integration, edge computing, 5G communication modules, and expanding product lines in smart wearables and healthcare.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IoT intelligent hardware products to downstream customers, including vehicle operation service providers and end users. The company employs ODM and OEM production models for customized products, especially in smart payment hardware and smart sleep terminals. It also generates income from investment returns and government subsidies, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Boshijie is recognized as a leading domestic player in IoT intelligent hardware, particularly in smart vehicle terminals and wireless communication modules. It holds multiple industry certifications and participates in setting national and industry standards. The company competes with other IoT and automotive electronics firms but distinguishes itself through vertical integration, core technology ownership, and a broad product portfolio covering multiple IoT application scenarios.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.4 billion, representing a 24.85% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 175.6 million, a 0.81% increase. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 2.49 billion. The company’s overseas revenue surged by nearly 400%, reflecting rapid international expansion. R&D expenses increased by 21.87%, accounting for 6.84% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Boshijie emphasizes its proprietary 'communication + positioning + AI' core technology platform and vertically integrated 'module + terminal' business model to deliver high-quality, reliable, and customizable IoT intelligent hardware solutions. Its products offer advanced features such as AI-driven driver assistance, real-time monitoring, and multi-modal positioning, tailored for diverse IoT scenarios. The company’s ability to rapidly adapt to customer needs and provide end-to-end solutions enhances its competitive edge and customer value.
